notes: WhaleChat 3.60.0 — TradingView removed: every price and performance chart is now the native green/red baseline chart, online and offline, with no invented prices while offline (charts pause on the last real tick); mobile view is the dark phone layout, desktop view the white wide layout, with Mobile/Auto/Desktop listed one after another and desktop as the default; one ConnectionManager keeps the app connected with a 30s heartbeat and silent resume; Sync-server/Reconnect UI removed; build now fails unless the sync function, quote proxy, shares engine and site all answer.
